args.summary: After this morning's deploy of v5.1.0 to all production regions, the payments service became unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Rolling back all production regions to the last known-healthy release, v5.0.0.
args.title: Payments errors after v5.1.0 deploy — rolling back to v5.0.0

**Issue found**
- The service is registered as **`payments-api`** (not "payments"). It was running **v5.1.0** across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), which had degraded after this morning's deploy with an **18% error rate**.
- Deployment history confirmed **v5.0.0** was the most recent healthy production release.

**Actions taken**
1. ✅ **Rollback** — Rolled all production regions back to **v5.0.0**; rollout completed successfully.
2. ✅ **Incident** — Opened **SEV2 incident `INC-0001`** documenting the errors after the v5.1.0 deploy and the rollback to v5.0.0; on-call has been paged.
3. ✅ **Verified** — `payments-api` is now healthy again (error rate down to 0.2%) running v5.0.0 in all regions.

Note: v5.1.0 had already been deployed to production (though degraded), so no change-manager approval was needed for this rollback to a previously healthy version.
